source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: زمان، الطريق عالمدرسة كان طويل وصعب.
sentences.en: Long ago, the road to school was long and hard.

sentences.ar: كنا نمشي نص ساعة بين الحقول والجبال.
sentences.en: We used to walk half an hour between the fields and mountains.

sentences.ar: بالشتا، الطريق كان يصير طين ومي.
sentences.en: In winter, the road would turn to mud and water.
And in summer, the sun would burn us.

sentences.ar: بس رغم هيك، كنا نروح كل يوم مبسوطين.
sentences.en: But despite this, we would go every day happily.
On the way, we would play, laugh, and race.

sentences.ar: مرة، لقينا كلب صغير تايه وجعان.
sentences.en: Once, we found a small lost and hungry dog.

sentences.ar: أطعمناه من زوادتنا، وصار يمشي معنا.
sentences.en: We fed it from our lunch, and it started walking with us.

sentences.ar: كل يوم، كان يستنانا عند نفس الشجرة.
sentences.en: Every day, it would wait for us by the same tree.

sentences.ar: سميناه صاحب، وصار جزء من طريقنا.
sentences.en: We named it Sahib, and it became part of our journey.
When we grew up and finished school, we parted.

sentences.ar: بس لهلأ، بتذكر هديك الطريق وصحابي.
sentences.en: But to this day, I remember that road and my friends.

sentences.ar: الطريق كان صعب، بس علمنا الصبر.
sentences.en: The road was hard, but it taught us patience.

sentences.ar: وعلمنا إنه الرفقة بتخفف أصعب طريق.
sentences.en: And it taught us that companionship eases the hardest road.

sentences.ar: لهلأ، كل ما أشوف مدرسة، بتذكر مشوارنا.
sentences.en: To this day, every time I see a school, I remember our journey.
